predictions.prediction_text: Continued vol selling will keep market swings contained and stabilize the downside for now.
predictions.expected_result: Intraday and multi-day SPX realized volatility remains suppressed and price stays within recent range rather than making large directional moves (no >2% one-day moves).

predictions.prediction_text: If Israel refrains from additional attacks, the geo-risk premium in oil will fade and a sustained jump above current oil levels is unlikely.
predictions.expected_result: Crude oil prices decline or revert toward pre-attack levels within days to weeks; oil does not record a sustained breakout above the recent peak (no multi-day trend higher).

predictions.prediction_text: Any new escalation in the Middle East will keep energy markets jittery and equity risk premia elevated, injecting downside risk into global equities.
predictions.condition: New escalation in the Middle East
predictions.expected_result: Oil and energy volatility spike and equity implied volatilities rise; equity indices experience downward pressure with increased probability of multi-day declines (>1-2%).

predictions.prediction_text: A vol-of-vol event (e.g., credit shock or geopolitical flashpoint) would reverse vol positioning and absorb downside gammas, causing larger market moves.
predictions.condition: Occurrence of a vol-of-vol event such as a credit shock or new geopolitical flashpoint
predictions.expected_result: Rapid expansion in VIX and VVIX and a sharp directional move in SPX (significant one- to three-day moves, e.g., >2%), breaking recent range and defeating premium-selling strategies.
